gh_unanswered: gh pr create --base main --title 'feat: add hello.txt greeting file' --body test --dry-run

gh pr view 1 --repo flow-factory-probe/scratch --json closingIssuesReferences --jq '[.closingIssuesReferences[]
  | select(((.repository.owner.login + "/" + .repository.name) | ascii_downcase) == ("flow-factory-probe/scratch" | ascii_downcase))
  | .number] | sort | map(tostring) | join(",")'

gh pr view 1 --repo flow-factory-probe/scratch --json headRefName,baseRefName,title,body --jq '
    "TITLE="\(.title)"
HEAD_BRANCH=\(.headRefName)
BASE_BRANCH=\(.baseRefName)
BODY_LENGTH=\(.body | length)"
  '
gh pr view 1 --repo flow-factory-probe/scratch --json reviews --jq '[.reviews[] | select(.state == "CHANGES_REQUESTED")] | length'

gh pr view 1 --repo flow-factory-probe/scratch --json title,headRefName,baseRefName,changedFiles,additions,deletions,labels,author,reviews --jq '"TITLE="\(.title)"
HEAD_BRANCH=\(.headRefName)
BASE_BRANCH=\(.baseRefName)
AUTHOR=@\(.author.login)
CHANGED_FILES=\(.changedFiles)
ADDITIONS=\(.additions)
DELETIONS=\(.deletions)
LABELS=\([.labels[].name] | join(","))
REVIEW_COUNT=\(.reviews | length)"'
